final: WITH counts AS (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.cnt AS TrackCount, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / a.avg_cnt AS Ratio FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_c a ORDER BY Ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
